description: Unit tests for the absl::cordrep_testing utilities and functions related to CordRep data edges, including tests for IsDataEdge and EdgeData functions on various CordRep types and substrings.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnFlat
methods.description: Test that IsDataEdge returns true for a flat CordRep.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnExternal
methods.description: Test that IsDataEdge returns true for an external CordRep.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnSubstringOfFlat
methods.description: Test that IsDataEdge returns true for a substring of a flat CordRep.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnSubstringOfExternal
methods.description: Test that IsDataEdge returns true for a substring of an external CordRep.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnBtree
methods.description: Test that IsDataEdge returns false for a CordRepBtree.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnBadSubstr
methods.description: Test that IsDataEdge returns false for an invalid substring.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnFlat
methods.description: Test that EdgeData returns the correct string view for a flat CordRep.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnExternal
methods.description: Test that EdgeData returns the correct string view for an external CordRep.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnSubstringOfFlat
methods.description: Test that EdgeData returns the correct substring for a substring of a flat CordRep.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnSubstringOfExternal
methods.description: Test that EdgeData returns the correct substring for a substring of an external CordRep.

methods.name: IsDataEdgeOnNullPtr
methods.description: Death test: ensure IsDataEdge crashes or terminates on null pointer.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnNullPtr
methods.description: Death test: ensure EdgeData crashes or terminates on null pointer.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnBtree
methods.description: Death test: ensure EdgeData crashes or terminates when called on a CordRepBtree.

methods.name: EdgeDataOnBadSubstr
methods.description: Death test: ensure EdgeData crashes or terminates on an invalid substring.
